acceptance.summary: NeuralOperator now uses hash-locked Python 3.12/Linux environments, immutable GitHub Actions, exact-head provenance manifests and complete autodiff workflow coverage.
verified_properties: requirements-py312-linux.lock and requirements-autodiff-py312-linux.lock enforce hashes with --require-hashes.
checkout, setup-python and upload-artifact actions are pinned by full commit SHA and Python 3.12.8 is explicit.
The reproducibility manifest records the pull-request head SHA through SOURCE_HEAD_SHA, checkout SHA, platform, interpreter and lock hash, with explicit dataset/checkpoint hash fields.
The optional autodiff workflow no longer has path filters that could skip code, script, test or lockfile changes.
AGENTS.md, the mandatory NeuralOperator ecosystem roadmap and license notices were read; scientific claims remain bounded by the repository documentation.
limitations: The locks qualify the declared Python 3.12/Linux reference environments; other interpreters, operating systems or hardware require their own locks and runs.
Dataset and checkpoint hashes are explicit not-provided fields until concrete immutable inputs are supplied.

local_checks: PYTHONPATH=src python3 -m unittest discover -s tests -v (85 tests, 28 optional PyTorch skips)

review.correction: The manifest workflows now pass github.event.pull_request.head.sha for PR qualification, with github.sha as the push fallback.

counting.rule: Count the technical PR exactly once; tracker commits are not counted.
